segments.text: The city archive shall provide free online access to final meeting minutes.
Documents must remain downloadable without an account.
The department will publish a pilot register by 30 June 2031.
A complete register is scheduled for 31 December 2031, subject to approved funding.
An external reviewer selected by the civic panel shall audit a sample of decisions each year.
The reviewer shall publish a summary that names no individual applicants.
